# OpenReel action core subset

Upstream: https://github.com/Augani/openreel-video/tree/367d7e90b61b5181f9861b852bb8b9d7a7d2954a

License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2024-2026 Augustus Otu and Contributors. Full license is retained at `upstream/LICENSE`.

`upstream/` contains byte-for-byte source content retrieved with the GitHub connector at the fixed commit. `SHA256.json` records content hashes. `actions.mjs` is generated by `npm run vendor:build` using the lockfile-pinned esbuild.

The sole build-time modification is the registration list in `actions/handlers/index.ts`: only `clip-timing` is registered. The original index is preserved unchanged. This excludes creation, motion, overlays, multicam, and bulk editing from this first-stage package. ActionExecutor's built-in clip, audio, subtitle and track implementations, validator, inverse generator and history are actual upstream code. Shader registry constants remain because the upstream executor imports them, but the application's facade forbids shader and unsupported action types. No FFmpeg WASM, AI SDK, GSAP, Three, desktop dependency, or external runtime dependency is included by this subset.

The application owns the frame/PTS project contract and uses a validated sidecar adapter. The UI is a small platform editing interface; it is **not** the full OpenReel UI, browser compositor, or serializer. The application performs JSON serialization after executing real upstream actions; full upstream ProjectSerializer and independent browser rendering remain unvalidated.

The platform adapter corrects upstream split fade inheritance: only the original left fade-in and right fade-out remain. A split inside either fade is explicitly rejected because this stage has no arbitrary gain-envelope representation. This is an adapter policy; upstream source and generated action bundle remain unchanged.
